title: Return Merchandise Authorization Form
subtitle: Return Merchandise Movement: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Return Merchandise Authorization Form controls return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody by tying each Return Merchandise Movement custody, document, or movement decision to the merchant / return authority, a stated boundary, and an expiry. The returns coordinator preserves conditions, exceptions, confirmation, and both sides of the handoff.
use_case: Use Return Merchandise Authorization Form at customer location, return dock, carrier route, quarantine zone, and disposition point. Check applicable Return Merchandise Movement requirements, list the affected quantity, value, document, route, or custody action, and state its limit. Record whether the merchant / return authority approves, conditions, holds, or declines the request; obtain renewed consent before changing return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody scope.

sections.title: Authorization request and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Return Merchandise Movement, identify responsible parties, customer location, return dock, carrier route, quarantine zone, and disposition point, and the linked return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody source.

fields.label: Item, serial, lot, quantity, and package

sections.title: Requested scope, limits, and decision lines
sections.guidance: Capture Return Merchandise Movement facts for return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Return Merchandise Movement authorization checks
items: Refund, replacement, repair, restock, or rejection routing

sections.title: Authorization conditions and final decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Return Merchandise Movement conditions; have returns coordinator assign the next Return Merchandise Movement owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Financial outcome requested before condition review
blocks.guidance: Pause Return Merchandise Movement when authorization, identity, safe handling, custody, or disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Return Merchandise Movement proof and route unresolved return authorization, item, reason, condition, packaging, and reverse-logistics custody scope to returns coordinator.
